scientific_limitations: Exact existence boundary for a non-EF1 online pure SPNE at three agents; does not establish all-equilibrium failure with seven goods. Two-round protection requires normalized monotone valuations and cyclic one-good picks. The finite witness is checked by a standalone exhaustive verifier. No independent audit performed and publication priority remains a risk.
title: Seven goods are the sharp first EF1-failure horizon for strategic three-agent round-robin
